_doc: Accepted production advisories. Each needs an owner, a reason it is not reachable, and an expiry — scripts/check-advisories.mjs fails CI once an entry expires or a high/critical advisory appears that isn't listed. See docs/security/dependency-advisories.md.

exceptions.reason: @puppeteer/browsers is loaded to spawn Chromium, but the vulnerable code (extract-zip unpacking, basic-ftp/get-uri/proxy-agent downloading) only runs when a browser is INSTALLED. src/lib/pdf/render-contract.ts always launches the @sparticuz/chromium executable and never installs or downloads one (pinned by src/__tests__/lib/render-contract-launch.test.ts). The fix is puppeteer-core 25, which needs Node >=22.12; CI and builds run Node 20.

sprintf-js is reached only through argparse, which mammoth uses for its command-line tool. The app calls mammoth.convertToHtml / extractRawText, which never touch argparse. npm's suggested fix is a major DOWNGRADE of mammoth.
